scenario: Interval `in` operator evaluated at runtime per LINT.1.1, as a `where` predicate over slots of one binding. Two Windows with distinct keys: probe=15 in (10..20) fires, probe=45 in (30..40) does not. Two Windows and one Hit leave 3 live facts.
rules_ds:
schema Window scope logical:
    start_t: Int key
    end_t: Int mutable
    probe: Int mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule in_range:
    Window w where w.probe in (w.start_t..w.end_t)
->
    emit Hit logical dummy: 0
